messages:
sienna (devex PM): Quick sync — Q3 devex roadmap: sample apps + SDK quickstarts. Need to pick 3 sample app themes (enterprise onboarding, multi-model routing, embeddings search) and decide polish vs breadth. Thoughts?

mike (dev): +1. My take: one polished onboarding flow for enterprise, plus two lean kits. Onboarding should include CI example and KMS/HSM stub.

leo (solutions eng): From customers: onboarding + telemetry hooks drive adoption. Also a demo showing Dedicated <-> Hosted switch would unblock a few POCs.

tara (docs): If we polish one, we can recycle into multiple quickstarts. Checklist suggestions: README, runnable CI, env seeding, small sample dataset, metrics dashboard.

jamal (growth): Marketing leans multi-model demos (shows cost controls), but onboarding shortens time-to-first-value. Recommend 60/40 onboarding tilt.

sienna (devex PM): Constraints: 8-week window. Proposed scope bundles — A) Polished enterprise onboarding app (deep walkthrough, CI, telemetry) B) Three lean starter kits (node/python/js + examples) C) Telemetry cookbook + Grafana dashboards. Please vote with emoji or comment.

mike (dev): Rough estimates: A) 4 dev-weeks + 1 QA + infra work. B) 3 kits x ~1 dev-week each. C) 2 dev-weeks to build exporter + sample dashboards.

leo (solutions eng): I can draft telemetry spec. Will include per-route/token cost breakdown, tail-latency SLO alerts, and a Prometheus exporter. Need sample Grafana panels for token-level cost.

mike (dev): Quick CI snippet we can include in onboarding quickstart:
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: npm ci && npm test
      - run: ./deploy.sh --env=staging
```

tara (docs): Nice. I'll create a reusable docs template: Overview, Getting started, CI, Telemetry, Troubleshooting. Will add a "What to fork" one-pager for solutions engs.

devrel-bot: Reminder: Please fill the Quickstart priority survey: https://forms.internal/RI-qs-pri (deadline: 2026-04-05)

jamal (growth): Filled the form. :white_check_mark:

sienna (devex PM): Converge plan: Ship lean kits first (early May), polished onboarding (late May), telemetry cookbook (June). Owners: @mike polished onboarding, @leo telemetry, @tara docs. I'll add milestones in Asana and link PR templates. Anyone object?

mike (dev): I can own the polished onboarding. Adding tech tasks to the board now.

leo (solutions eng): I'll own telemetry. Will post a proto dashboard link tomorrow and list required ingest metrics.

tara (docs): I'll pair with Mike next Tue to draft the runbook and quickstart structure.

sienna (devex PM): Great. Action items: 1) Mike: skeleton app + Dockerfile by EOW; 2) Leo: telemetry spec + prometheus exporter proto; 3) Tara: docs template + checklist. We'll sync again in 5 days. :rocket:
